@AGENTS.md

## Skills available in this repo

- `skills/decision-spine/` — apply the Decision Spine to a system. Invoked when
  designing, reviewing at a gate, or writing an architecture document.
- `skills/field-note/` — capture what a domain practitioner knows and promote it
  into an ADR, a test, or a project constraint. Invoked when someone says they
  have seen something go wrong in the field, when writing or dispositioning a
  field note, and when someone says they do not write software.
- `skills/survey/` — run the intake that precedes a build: constraints, load,
  invariants, and a readiness verdict on every decision before any ADR is written.
  Invoked when scoping a new system or feature, when asked what still needs to be
  decided, when generating a handoff package, and when a build's ADRs keep churning.
  Before the build is decided, it runs a Recon (`templates/recon.md`): the record
  of a first session with a problem owner, a probe to scope, and an estimate that
  shows what it rests on, for a go/no-go.

- `skills/backfill/` — bring a system that already exists under the decision
  record: existing decisions become Ground rows and closed spine rows. Invoked
  when Causeway arrived after the build, when most spine rows are open on a system
  that has answers, or when `impact.sh` finds nothing.
- `skills/upgrade/` — move the project to a newer published Causeway release in
  one reviewable pull request. Invoked when asked to upgrade, re-sync or re-pin.

`tools/sync.sh` also installs each of these as `.claude/skills/causeway-<name>/`,
where Claude Code discovers it without this list.

managed policy > this file / project rules > user (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md)
